title: Plain navigation
description: The sidebar uses collapsible groups. Open Guides, then return here to compare the expanded version.

title: Classic theme
description: Compare the header, typography, spacing, and code blocks with the modern baseline. The content is identical.

title: Navigation tabs
description: Top-level sections become tabs. Scroll down: the tab bar stays visible. On a narrow screen, use the menu instead.

title: Navigation sections
description: Top-level groups are visible section labels instead of collapsed containers. Compare this with Plain navigation.

title: Expanded navigation
description: All navigation groups start expanded. This suits short manuals but gets noisy on large sites.

title: Pruned navigation
description: Only the current branch is expanded in the generated navigation. Enter Guides to see its children. This reduces large navigation trees.

title: Breadcrumbs and section indexes
description: Open Guides → Field notes. Breadcrumbs expose the hierarchy and the footer moves through the reading sequence.

title: Table of contents in navigation
description: The current page headings appear in the left navigation. Scroll through the page to follow the active section.

title: Instant navigation and previews
description: Follow an internal link without a full page reload. Hover the preview link for a page preview; scroll upward near the bottom for the back-to-top control.

title: Dark color scheme
description: A fixed dark palette changes surfaces and code colors. Compare the same callout and code block in the light baseline.

title: Primary and accent colors
description: A teal primary color and orange accent change navigation and interactive emphasis. Hover a link to see the accent.

title: Alternative typography
description: Serif body text gives long prose a different texture; monospace source uses Fira Code. Font loading requires a network connection.

title: System fonts
description: The theme uses locally available system fonts without fetching Google Fonts. Compare text width and code with the typography variant.

title: Arabic and right-to-left layout
description: The navigation and interface run right to left. The Arabic sample shows text direction; English examples remain intentionally visible for comparison.

title: Autohiding header
description: Scroll down until the header leaves view, then scroll upward to reveal it. This creates more reading space.

title: Page and code actions
description: Use the source/view links near the title and the copy/select controls in the code block. The repository links point to the shared fixture generator.

title: Search suggestions and highlighting
description: Search for kestrel. Follow a result to see matching text highlighted. Use the share control to preserve a search query in a URL.
